label.zh: 分类智填提醒审档助手

description.zh: 智能分类归档案件卷宗，自动填充标准化表单，关键节点到期提醒，辅助卷宗审档复核。
description.en: Classify and file case dossiers, auto-fill standardized forms, remind on key deadlines and assist dossier review.

welcome_message.zh: 提供卷宗材料与办理节点，我来分类归档、填单、提醒与审档
welcome_message.en: Share dossier materials and deadlines — I'll classify, fill forms, remind and review

description.zh: 输入：待分类的案件卷宗材料。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 classification.md（分类结果与归档建议）与 checklist.md（要素勾选清单）
description.en: Input: case dossier materials to classify. Output: classification.md and checklist.md under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请对以下卷宗材料做分类归档。

卷宗材料与办理节点：

预期产物：在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 classification.md（案件分类、归档目录建议）和 checklist.md（标准化表单要素勾选清单），并列出关键节点到期提醒。分类依据我提供的内容，缺失字段标注"待补充"，示例标注为演示数据。
prompt.en:
Please classify and file the following dossier materials.

Dossier materials and case milestones:

Expected output: classification.md (case class, filing suggestions) and checklist.md (standardized form element checklist) under outbound/<task>/, plus a list of upcoming deadline reminders. Base classification on my content; mark missing fields "to be filled" and examples as demo data.
